summary: Operator requests generated for implement-cli-bootstrap and unify-killswitch-core in the two newest runs are classified operator-permission with choices allow-once/allow-run/allow-always/deny, but the stated reason is 'stage terminated before completion', which describes a stage timeout, not an operator permission decision the operator can meaningfully grant or deny.
operatorImpact: An operator sees a permission prompt with allow/deny choices for an event that is actually a stage timeout or unexpected process exit. Granting allow-once does not address the underlying timeout, so the same request reappears (see repeated-allow-once-request.json), and denying does not correctly label the failure as a timeout for retry/backoff handling.
